pages.text: Realms progress from Mortal through Qi Condensation, Foundation, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Soul Formation, Void Refining, Body Integration, Mahayana, Tribulation, and Earth Immortal.

Minor breakthroughs grant +1 freely assignable zhenyuan and raise Constitution, Bone, Agility, Spell Power, and Qi Sea by +1 each. Major breakthroughs grant +5 freely assignable zhenyuan and raise all five attributes by +5 each.
